name: Budha
description: Mattress and sommier brand in Uruguay with an online store on WooCommerce. Lists classic and premium mattresses, box sommiers and sommier sets. States free shipping across the country by carrier agency, same-day delivery in Montevideo and 24 to 72 hours in Maldonado and Canelones.
description_es: Marca uruguaya de colchones y sommiers con tienda online en WooCommerce. Ofrece colchones clásicos y premium, sommiers box y conjuntos. Indica envío gratis a todo el país por agencia, entrega en el día en Montevideo y de 24 a 72 horas en Maldonado y Canelones.

ships_to.notes: Free shipping to all of Uruguay by agency. Same-day in Montevideo; 24 to 72 hours in Maldonado and Canelones; other interior times not listed.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Lists store hours for Maldonado and Punta del Este; in-store pickup is not stated.
